AND A.STATUS = 'B'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #{st_dept}
AND A.IRS_NO LIKE #{st_irs_no} || '%'
AND A.IRS_NM LIKE '%'||#{st_buyer_name} || '%'
ORDER BY A.IRS_NM , A.DEPT_NM
